<div class="card-body">
'''Turbolaser Battery''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ターボレーザー砲塔</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して、任意の「スター・デストロイヤー」か移動要塞の星系カードに配備する。２フォース消費して起動する。運命数を２回引く。運命数の合計－２＞装甲値で、大型艦に命中する。運命数の合計－５＞回避値で宇宙船に命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-323o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">超高出力のブラスター。動力炉と極低温冷却装置、そして多数の操作員を必要とする。宇宙戦闘機よりは、大型艦に対して本領を発揮する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Turbolaser Turret.

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on any Star Destroyer or mobile fortress system card. Use 2 Force to fire. Draw destiny twice. A capital ship is hit if total destiny −2 exceeds its armor. A starship is hit if total destiny −5 exceeds its maneuver.

'''Lore:''' An extremely high-output blaster that requires a reactor, cryogenic cooling, and a large crew. Most effective against capital ships rather than starfighters.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Turbolaser Battery]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
